content.title: Video-Assisted Thoracoscopic (VATS) Right Upper Lobectomy
content.rawText: Patient Vikram Malhotra (ABHA: 14-1234-5678-9012) underwent uneventful VATS right upper lobectomy and radical systemic mediastinal lymphadenectomy (stations 2R, 4R, 7, 10R). Chest tube placed on -20 cmH2O suction.

sections.clinicalSummary: VATS Right Upper Lobectomy + Mediastinal Node Dissection. Uneventful procedure.
